witness.quote: Where angle parking is permitted, no person shall stand or park a vehicle unless the front of the vehicle is pointed toward the direction of lawful traffic movement.
witness.reason: The fixed one-way-road angle-parking designation supports the orientation branch once actual permission is independently established.
